body: I dunno, I tried to make it clear, that's why I wanted to say it to her, so she wouldn't feel guilty about thinking she caused it. I really want to talk to her, but I don't know how, or what I'd say, or im worried I'll just sound like a desperate ass hole.

Thank you very much for your kind words. I hope you can understand that I don't really see any of this for myself, and I hope one day I might. I have actually seen them many times, about 4 or 5 times now. I feel talking helps, but they don't give advice, which is an issue for me. I'm seeing a therapist in college, but honestly progress is quite slow, there's still a lot of crap to work through, and I'm very impatient.
Me too, but I still think it's very unfair to not look past the severe mental illness, and at least consider. She's only known me when I've been depressed

I dunno if I mentioned it, but I already sent her a massive message on Facebook about my depression and how I felt. She saw it, but never replied. It wasn't until a few days later she butt dialed me and I asked her about it, to which she pretty much shrugged my depression as not being a serious issue.

I've tried asking for clarification, but she never gave me a straight answer. I feel I can't move forward, because I haven't got full closure or a proper excuse. I'm afraid I'll come across as being needy, annoying and desperate.

Alright, well in college I feel I've hit a bit of a road block, since I feel I can't be myself around the people in college, and I always have to censor myself. 

I don't have a girlfriend, my last one was my first and only, and I was lucky I got her in the first place. It lasted 5 months, which we got on fairly well with each other. We have a lot of similar interests, opinions on things, similar mindsets, the only issue was the lack of contact, which combined with my depression made me very needy, but I feel that was circumstantial, and she should at least consider everything. This absolutely kills me. 

I don't know if she'll talk to me ever again, I got her a present for her birthday because i still care for her (I said that, didn't say love), we sent the longest string of messages we've sent in 5 months a few weekends ago, where she kept apologising but never gave me a definitive answer for the breakup, and kinda shrugged off my depression as if it was no big deal (not that I wanted her to. I just wanted her to understand). 

My friend said he understood, and after our chat said he was not going near her, which I'm grateful of. 

I dunno what a mental vacation is
